title: Adjuvant icotinib for resected EGFR-mutated stage II–IIIA non-small-cell lung cancer (ICTAN, GASTO1002): a randomized comparison study
time_scope: The main efficacy analysis and data cutoff reported in this article.
excluded: The 6-month icotinib arm and all comparisons involving it
Landmark survival rates, event-count endpoints, subgroup/per-protocol analyses, quality of life and safety
population_or_material: The ICTAN intention-to-treat population with completely resected EGFR-mutated stage II–IIIA NSCLC after adjuvant chemotherapy.
requested_items: DFS: reported arm medians and primary DFS HR; OS/BMFS: primary HRs only. Exclude landmark rates, event counts, per-protocol and subgroup analyses.
